programme.title: The Rescue

programme.title: Golden Chicken
programme.desc: When Ah Kam, a prostitute, ends up locked in a cash machine vestibule with a would-be thief, the discovery that they are both ill-fated results in her narrating her life story.

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend

programme.title: Touch of the Light

programme.title: Lion Rock

programme.desc: A retired spy Ling Ling Chat, now a meat vendor is brought in to investigate a case after a giant dinosaur skull is stolen.
